expect.case: API request hits the 200-record table storage limit; recipe stops before returning a response

scalar_encoding_semantics.workato_checkbox_control: Boolean-declared checkbox controls accept JSON booleans or the authoring strings true and false.
scalar_encoding_semantics.workato_numeric_control: Integer and number response controls accept mathematically compatible numeric expressions; numeric strings are coerced by controls that declare numeric output conversion.
scalar_encoding_semantics.workato_text_control: String-declared text controls accept string, integer, number, or boolean scalar expressions and apply Workato's text coercion.

stop_reason.literal: Amount of invoices found hits table storage limit, please consider increasing search size
